description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Squee, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {C}{C}.
When Squee dies, Brenard triggers, exiling Squee from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is a 1/1 Food Golem artifact creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Squee token, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Squee token, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Squee from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
